geography: United States. 2008Q2-2016Q4 rows: U.S. net sales of Relistor reported by the licensee (Wyeth, Salix, Valeant) to licensor Progenics Pharmaceuticals and stated in Progenics' 10-Q and 10-K; 2017Q1-2021Q4 rows: U.S. sales of Salix products in Bausch Health's earnings presentations.
formulation: subcutaneous injection and oral tablet (aggregated in one row)

approval_evidence.quote: RELISTOR METHYLNALTREXONE BROMIDE 12MG/0.6ML SOLUTION;SUBCUTANEOUS ... 04/24/2008 ORIG-1 Approval

series_start_reason: 2008Q2 is the launch quarter: Progenics' Q1 2009 10-Q says global Relistor net sales 'began last June' (June 2008), and the FY2009 10-K prints 2008 net sales from Wyeth only from the second quarter. Rows before 2017Q1 are read from Progenics Pharmaceuticals' Forms 10-Q and 10-K, which state the U.S. Relistor net sales its licensee reported to it each quarter (Wyeth, then Salix from April 2011, then Valeant from April 2015); the same U.S. scope as the Bausch Health rows, and the Progenics 2017 10-Qs state U.S. figures (13.5, 16.3, 16.9 million for 1Q17 to 3Q17) that round to the 13, 16 and 17 in the Bausch Health presentation. The 3Q16 (22) and 4Q16 (15) presentation figures stay unused because that Branded Rx segment included Canada; Progenics' U.S. line replaces them. Salix's own filings fold Relistor into 'Other' and Valeant's 10-Qs and 10-Ks print no Relistor dollar figure, so Progenics is the only public issuer printing the line before 2017.
series_end_reason: The 4Q21 presentation is the last to print a Relistor row in a 'Top 10 Products' table. From 1Q22 the realigned segment structure dropped the per-segment top-10 tables; the 1Q22 to 2Q25 presentations print only growth rates and segment-mix shares for Relistor, and the 8-K earnings releases print only growth wording. From 3Q25 the Salix segment slide prints dollar figures for the three Salix products in an unlabelled chart table (the product names are graphics, not text, so no row can be tied to the label 'Relistor'), which would also leave 1Q22-2Q25 empty.
notes: Scope proof: every row is the Salix (or, 1Q17-1Q18, Branded Rx) slide; the Salix segment is 'sales in the U.S. of GI products' (FY2018 to FY2021 10-Ks) and the Salix slides of the 1Q20 to 4Q21 presentations carry the footnote 'U.S. sales only'. The 'Top 10 Products - Total BAUSCH Health' slide also prints a global Relistor row for 1Q20 to 4Q21 that is $0-1M higher in some quarters (1Q20 32 vs 31; 2Q20 27 vs 26; 1Q21 32 vs 30), so the U.S. line was used. Aggregation: the row combines Relistor injection and Relistor tablets (3Q17 presentation footnote 2); the FY2016 10-K reports a $50 million milestone paid in the third quarter of 2016 for the FDA approval of Oral Relistor. Issuer: Valeant Pharmaceuticals International, Inc. (renamed Bausch Health Companies Inc. in 2018) is one filer (CIK 885590) so no join. FY sums of the quarterly rows match the printed fiscal-year columns: 2017 71, 2018 97, 2019 110, 2020 114, 2021 129. Independent cross-check, not used as a source: Progenics Pharmaceuticals, the licensor, prints 'RELISTOR U.S.' net sales reported by its licensee in its 10-Qs (e.g. 1Q18 20.3, 2Q18 23.5, 3Q18 32.4, 1Q19 26.4, 2Q19 23.8, 3Q19 32.6, 1Q20 31.1 million USD), which agree with the rounded deck figures; Progenics (CIK 835887) could extend the history to 2016 in a separate series but is a different issuer and unit precision. Extension 2008Q2-2016Q4: one scope, U.S. net sales of Relistor as reported by the licensee, taken from Progenics Pharmaceuticals (CIK 835887). Quarters 2008Q2-2011Q2 are prose sentences in USD millions to one decimal; 2011Q3 is a table in millions; 2011Q4 onward are tables in thousands. Fourth quarters are the 10-K full-year U.S. figure less the nine months printed in the Q3 10-Q. Each year's quarters sum to the printed full-year U.S. figure (2008 2.8, 2009 7.1, 2010 9.5, 2011 21.5, 2012 29.2, 2013 35.0, 2014 16.2, 2015 40.7, 2016 66.9 million) within the one-decimal rounding of the 2008-2011 prose. Pre-June-2008 there are no sales. Worldwide net sales (U.S. plus ex-U.S.) are also printed by Progenics and are not used.
search_log: Bigdata.com smart search for Bausch Health Relistor revenue located the Salix segment slides; the Q2 2026 deck prints 'RELISTOR $41' for 2Q26 (change -$6M) in a graphic table whose product names are images.

Listed every Bausch Health filing for CIK 0000885590 via data.sec.gov/submissions (all forms incl. 8-K/A and 10-K/A); downloaded all 10-Ks 2016-2026 and every 8-K exhibit 99.x 2016-2026. 10-Ks and 8-K releases print Relistor only in prose (e.g. growth percentages); no product-level dollar row.

Quarterly product dollar figures are printed in the 'Top 10 Products' slides of the earnings presentations on ir.bauschhealth.com (events-and-presentations/<year>. pages list the files); decks 3Q17, 4Q17, 1Q18, 2Q18, 3Q18, 4Q18 (FY18), 1Q19-4Q19, 1Q20-4Q20, 1Q21-4Q21 parsed with pdfplumber (work/scan.py, work/build.py) from the header columns of each slide; the 1Q17 and 2Q17 presentations print no Relistor row.

Earnings decks on ir.bauschhealth.com for every quarter 1Q22 through 2Q26 (1Q22, 2Q22, 3Q22, 4Q22/FY22, 1Q23, 2Q23, 3Q23, 4Q23/FY23, 1Q24, 2Q24, 3Q24, 4Q24/FY24, 1Q25, 2Q25, 3Q25, 4Q25/FY25, 1Q26, 2Q26) were text-extracted with pdfplumber; none of 1Q22 to 2Q25 carries a Relistor dollar figure (growth rates and mix shares only); 3Q25 onward prints figures without a text label (see series_end_reason).

Prior owner: Salix Pharmaceuticals (CIK 1009356) 10-Qs and 10-Ks for 2013-2014 fold Relistor into a row 'Other - Anusol/Azasan/Diuril/Pepcid/Proctocort/Relistor/Deflux/Solesta/Fulyzaq/Metozolv' (e.g. 10-Q filed 2014-11-07), so there is no Salix Relistor line.
Royalty holder: Progenics 10-Qs print quarterly U.S. and worldwide Relistor net sales as reported by the licensee from 2016; used only as a cross-check of the deck figures (notes).
Fiscal-year checks against the printed FY column of each Q4 slide: 2017 71, 2018 97, 2019 110, 2020 114, 2021 129 all equal the sum of the four quarterly rows.

Extension (earlier quarters): Valeant/Bausch Health CIK 885590 10-Qs and 10-Ks filed 2015-04 to 2016-11 and every Item 2.02 8-K in that window downloaded and searched for 'Relistor': no dollar net-sales figure, only acquisition, contingent-consideration and growth wording. Salix CIK 1009356 was already checked (Relistor inside 'Other').

Progenics Pharmaceuticals CIK 835887: every 10-Q and 10-K 2008-2018 downloaded; the licensee-reported Relistor net sales (U.S. and ex-U.S.) are stated in MD&A prose for 2008Q2-2011Q2 (the 2008 10-Qs and the FY2008 10-K print only worldwide sales; the 2008 U.S. quarters come from the 2009 10-Q comparatives), in a net sales table from the Q3 2011 10-Q, and in the Q1 2017 and later 10-Qs for overlap with the Bausch Health rows.
No U.S. split exists before 2008Q2: Relistor was approved in April 2008 and Progenics recognised royalty income from June 2008.

launch_evidence.quote: Global net sales of RELISTOR, which began last June, were $1.9 million for the first quarter of 2009

reviewed_anomalies.2008Q3: 0.1 million in 2008Q3 between 1.9 million in 2008Q2 and 0.8 million in 2008Q4, each stated as a prior-year comparison in the 2009 10-Qs; the three quarters sum to the 2.8 million 2008 year in the FY2009 10-K.
reviewed_anomalies.2011Q1: The Q1 2011 10-Q printed 2.3 million U.S.; the Q1 2012 10-Q prior-year column prints 1,800 thousand, which is the figure consistent with nine months 2011 of 13.5 million (1.8 + 3.5 + 8.2). The later, consistent figure is used.
reviewed_anomalies.2011Q3: 8.2 million after 3.5 million, as printed in the Q3 2011 10-Q; Salix assumed U.S. distribution on 2011-04-01.
reviewed_anomalies.2012Q3: Fall from 10.0 to 3.8 million as printed in the Q3 2012 10-Q (and 3.8 in its nine-month figure of 25,100 less 21,300 for the first six months).
reviewed_anomalies.2013Q4: Derived as 35,000 less nine months 17,100 = 17,900 thousand (FY2013 10-K and Q3 2013 10-Q); a rise from 3.7 million in 2013Q3.
reviewed_anomalies.2014Q4: Negative: the FY2014 10-K states the licensee reported sales deductions in excess of gross sales (net losses) in the fourth quarter of 2014; 16,200 full year less 21,600 nine months = -5,400 thousand.
reviewed_anomalies.2015Q1: Negative: the Q1 2015 10-Q prints net sales (losses) of (200) thousand U.S., attributed to a wholesaler inventory reduction initiative.
reviewed_anomalies.2016Q3: Step to 21.5 million from 14.6 million as printed in the Q3 2016 10-Q (Oral Relistor approved July 2016).
